_note: Florida pony stable (DESIGN.md section 3): groom (the paper-doll makeover on a pony), ride (mounted click-to-move, faster), foals (coat and mane traits mix, genetics played straight and joyful). Pure play: no scoring, nothing can be done wrong. Genes: each pony carries two alleles per gene; 'dominance' lists alleles strongest first and the strongest allele of the pair is the one you see. A foal gets one allele per gene from each parent, picked at random. 'cast' and 'foal_names' are cast ids in data/cast.json (shown through Cast.short). The herd lives in WorldState flag fl_ponies; the pony being ridden in fl_riding. Art: tools/gen_pony_sprites.py writes the rigged part sheets assets/florida/pony_*.png from these colours.

Today smells like hay and sunshine.
brush: Long strokes, the way the hair goes. Perfect.
I feel so shiny I could sparkle. Oh, I am sparkling!
